## Parent

turnkey-vnm

## What to build

With `buck2.testCache.enable` (a new option, default true), the generated .buckconfig sets our runner as `[test] v2_test_executor`, and `tk test` runs every test through it. Caching is off: the runner sends `disable_test_execution_caching` and records nothing. What the user sees is unchanged from buck2's bundled runner (spec §5).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `tk test //...` gives the same pass/fail outcome per target as before
- [ ] stdout/stderr are shown in each test's details as before
- [ ] `-- --env K=V`, `-- --timeout N` and `-- --test-arg X` behave as with buck2's runner
- [ ] Exit code is 0 when everything passes and 32 when any test fails
- [ ] `buck2.testCache.enable = false` removes the runner from the generated .buckconfig

title: Test runner runs tests at parity with buck2's runner
